actions.name: deadly leap
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} jumps at least [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=1vGEpDSCHfEAoC4w]] as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a [[/save activity=1vGEpDSCHfEAoC4w]] saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked &reference[prone] and take [[/damage average activity=1vGEpDSCHfEAoC4w]]. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls &reference[prone] in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space.

actions.name: standing leap
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s &reference[long jump] is up to 30 feet and its &reference[high jump] is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.
